summary: Terms and Conditions feature fully tested and working. Fixed critical bug: TermsModal component was imported but NOT rendered in DealerDashboard.js. After fix, all tests pass.
passed_tests: Backend: Register new dealer returns terms_accepted=false
Backend: Admin can approve dealer via /api/dealers/{id}/approve
Backend: Login returns terms_accepted field in response
Backend: POST /api/auth/accept-terms updates terms_accepted to true
Backend: Login returns terms_accepted=true after accepting
Backend: Accept terms rejects invalid token
Frontend: Terms Modal appears automatically for new dealer after login
Frontend: Modal shows terms content with articles
Frontend: Checkbox and Accept button are present
Frontend: Clicking Accept without checkbox shows error toast
Frontend: Checking checkbox and clicking Accept closes modal
Frontend: Modal does NOT reappear after page refresh
Frontend: Dashboard loads correctly after accepting terms
critical_code_review_comments: FIXED: TermsModal was imported but NOT rendered in DealerDashboard.js - added <TermsModal isOpen={showTermsModal} onAccept={handleTermsAccepted} token={token} /> to JSX
Added data-testid='terms-checkbox' to TermsModal.js for better testability
